item.title: Australian Dollar remains subdued following softer S&P Global PMI data
item.description: Australian Dollar (AUD) holds losses against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian hours on Friday. The AUD/USD pair trades around 0.7040 at the time of writing after giving up recent gains from the previous session.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD attracts sellers for the fifth consecutive day
item.description: The GBP/USD pair prolongs its weekly downtrend for the fifth consecutive day on Friday and slides back closer to a nearly one-month low, touched the previous day.

item.title: GBP/USD: Break of 50-day MA leaves Pound vulnerable – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank analysts Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note that GBP/USD is trading defensively below 1.35, extending weekly losses as weaker jobs data and narrower yield spreads erode support.

item.title: US Dollar Index holds onto gains near 98.00 ahead of US flash Q4 GDP, PMI data
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) shows strength during the early European trading session on Friday, with the US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trading firmly near an almost four-week high of 98.00 posted the previous day.

item.title: USD/INR gaps higher as INR slumps due to FII selling, rising oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) gaps down at open against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday after a holiday on Thursday.

item.title: Gold rises for third day as geopolitical risks counter Fed outlook ahead of US data
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) gains some positive traction for the third consecutive day on Friday. The upside potential, however, seems limited amid the mixed fundamental backdrop.

item.title: EUR/USD: Options signal Dollar concern – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister notes that while EUR/USD has slipped back below 1.18 and the Euro’s spot gains versus the Dollar are modest year-to-date, options markets still reflect a structural shift since “Liberation Day.” He argues that investors increasingly use EUR options to hedge Dollar risk,

item.title: Oil: Geopolitical tension lifts prices – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Molly Schwartz notes that crude Oil has reacted sharply to shifting US–Iran headlines, with prices rising to $72 per barrel, the highest since early August.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Slips to near 0.5950 due to fading momentum
item.description: NZD/USD has pared its recent gains registered in the previous session, trading around 0.5950 during the Asian hours on Friday. The technical analysis of the daily chart signals an emergence of the bearish reversal as the pair price is positioned below the lower ascending channel boundary.

item.title: RBNZ: OCR on hold as recovery remains fragile – UOB
item.description: UOB Global Economics & Markets Research notes that the Reserve Bank of New Zealand left the Official Cash Rate unchanged at 2.25%, consistent with expectations.
